summary: Iteration 3 (both backend + frontend). Backend: rewrote test_backend.py against new no-demo, owner-scoped API. 37/37 pytest tests pass in ~9s covering: auth (demo endpoint removed → 404; login/register/me have no 'mode' field), owner isolation (fresh user sees no SMP Tes; seed user has Ani+Budi), formats verification (75/155/200/210/265 all balanced), schools/classes CRUD + PATCH + DELETE cascade with audit log actions delete_school/delete_class/delete_respondent, bulk /api/respondents/bulk (happy 2-item save; 422 with detail.row_errors for out-of-range; 422 for heavy not subset; 400 for empty items), konseling board (returns only want_discussion=Ya; PATCH status transitions Belum→Dijadwalkan with note; invalid status → 400), rekap/trend (years[]+series[].points[]), analysis deterministic for individual/group/school, real AI narrative call to gpt-5.4 via Emergent key succeeded (~5s) and second call returned cached=True with identical narrative, PDF/xlsx export with %PDF magic bytes, scoring/group has consultation field, rekap/school, rekap/comparison, audit/individual breakdown, import/excel valid path. Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844 login with seeded credentials succeeded; all critical testIDs render (active-school-banner, logout-button, new-respondent-button, bulk-wizard-button, dashboard-konseling-card, tab-konseling, konseling-count-Belum, analitik-tab-{kelas,sekolah,bandingkan,tren}, trend-chart, add-class-button, edit-school-button); session persistence across full page reload confirmed. Two documented bugs from iteration 2 are RESOLVED: parse_problem_numbers now handles pandas float coercion (server.py:782-783); however the score_individual→FORMATS[format_id] leak still exists but is dead-code because RespondentInput+scoring/individual endpoint accept only preset format_ids via UI — not retested explicitly in this iteration.

minor.issue: Duplicated key 'owner_id' set twice in dict literal at server.py:400-401 and 427-428 (harmless — same value — but code smell).
Legacy: still accesses FORMATS[format_id] before validate_selection so unknown format_id can leak KeyError 500. Not retested with xfail this iteration; low-risk since UI only sends known IDs.

action_items: (Optional) Clean up duplicated `owner_id` key in POST /api/schools (server.py:400-401) and POST /api/classes (server.py:427-428) — harmless duplicate literal.

(Optional) Refactor score_individual: call FORMATS.get() first or run validate_selection before FORMATS[format_id] lookup so unknown format ids return 400 instead of 500. Same as iteration 2 note; not blocking the current PRD flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1218 lines — well over the 700-line split threshold; recommend extracting analysis/, export/, scoring/, and importing modules to keep future edits safe.

AI cache key uses (owner_id, scope, identifier, data_hash) but the GET /api/analysis/{scope}/{identifier} endpoint compares only data_hash, which is fine but note that any change in highlights/priorities invalidates cache — deliberate and correct.
delete_respondent_docs cleans respondents + processing_results but leaves audit_logs referencing deleted respondent_ids. By design (audit trail), but confirm in PRD.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testIDs verified (16/16 checks); wizard/bulk-wizard multi-step flows and logout confirm from dashboard header were not exercised end-to-end due to time budget

seed_data_creation: Backend suite registers ephemeral TEST_<uuid>@aum.local users and creates 'TEST Cascade SMP', 'TEST ClassCascade', 'TEST RespDel', 'TEST BulkSchool', 'TEST AI School' — all cascade-deleted or scoped to throwaway users. Seed account gurubk.tes@sekolah.id received 2 TEST_imp* respondents via /import/excel; consider a cleanup pass if repeated reruns should not accumulate. Ani and Budi seed respondents were NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend PRD endpoints verified against public preview URL. Seed account (gurubk.tes@sekolah.id / rahasia123) has SMP Tes/VII A/Ani+Budi and now also 2 accumulated TEST_imp* respondents from the import happy-path test — safe to ignore or delete. AI narrative test proved the real Emergent LLM key works and the cached:true path is honoured. Frontend wizard multi-step (WizardView) and bulk-wizard grid tap sequence were NOT executed step-by-step; testIDs are present in the code (verified via grep) and the buttons entering them are visible from the dashboard. If a future iteration wants full E2E coverage, follow the sequences documented in review_request features 12-13.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing feature. Iteration 2's parse_problem_numbers leading-zero import bug is fixed in server.py:782-783 by short-circuiting `isinstance(value, (int, float))` before the regex path. Demo mode has been fully purged: /api/auth/demo returns 404 as required; login/register/me responses no longer include a 'mode' key; all reads are owner_id-scoped. Cascade delete verified end-to-end (create school → class → respondent → DELETE school → all three gone, audit trail present).
